title: Four-dimensional imaging using a one-dimensional transducer array combining photoacoustic signals with ultrasonic timecoding
authors: Yingjie Feng; Simin Wang; Yang Liu; Qiuqin Mao; Tianxiang Zuo; Yifan Yang; Chao Tao; Xiaojun Liu
matched_query: photoacoustic imaging ultrasonic timecoding 4D volumetric one-dimensional array acoustic coded imaging
reasons: directly combines photoacoustic signals with ultrasonic time-coding for scan-free volumetric image formation
encodes elevational spatial information into temporal delays of orthogonally emitted ultrasound, making it a strong acoustic-coded-imaging contribution
uses a one-dimensional transducer array to recover single-shot 3D volumes without mechanical scanning or a complex two-dimensional receive array
demonstrates real-time 4D imaging by tracking a moving microbead at 10 Hz
the authoritative APS version-of-record verifies title, complete authorship, DOI, publication date, volume and article number
summary_en: Introduces PAUTC, a scan-free 4D photoacoustic imaging strategy that synchronizes pulsed optical excitation with orthogonal ultrasound emissions so elevational position is time-coded into scattered echoes; a 1D array then reconstructs single-shot 3D volumes and supports 10 Hz dynamic imaging.
